questions.q: What happens if you leave a required column blank while filling in a template?
options: Excel immediately crashes
The entire workbook deletes itself
Nothing happens at data-entry time, but that row will be rejected later during the import process's validation
Oracle automatically fills in a default value for every blank required field
questions.explain: Data entry itself doesn't validate business rules. A missing required value is only caught — and the row rejected — when the import process runs its validation.

questions.q: Why can Excel's own formatting cause problems for FBDI data entry?
options: A displayed date or number can store a different underlying value than what's shown, or a text-formatted cell can keep leading zeros a numeric cell would drop
Excel never has any formatting options
Excel formatting has no effect on what gets written to a CSV file
Formatting only matters for printed reports, never for data
questions.explain: What a cell displays and what Excel actually stores can differ, especially for dates and numbers, which can silently corrupt data before it's even exported.

questions.q: A field expects the Oracle lookup code 'USD'. What happens if you type 'US Dollars' instead?
options: It works fine because Oracle understands synonyms
It fails, because coded lookup fields require the exact code, not a human-friendly label
Oracle automatically converts it to the correct code
It only matters for optional fields, never for required ones
questions.explain: Lookup fields expect the exact configured code. A friendly label that a person would understand is not the same as the code the system requires.

questions.q: What does the 'one row, one record' rule mean on an FBDI template's data tab?
options: Templates can only have one row total
You may only load one record total per template, ever
Each column may only contain one letter
Each row must contain exactly one business record (or line), with no stray blank rows or leftover sample rows mixed in
questions.explain: Every row represents exactly one record or line. Blank or leftover sample rows get picked up during CSV generation and can cause rejected or garbage rows.

questions.q: What's the best way to find out whether a given column on a template is required?
options: Guess based on the column's position
Assume every column is always optional
Check the template's Instructions tab or Oracle's published field reference for that import
Ask a coworker who has never used that template either
questions.explain: The Instructions tab and Oracle's documented field reference are the reliable sources for which columns are mandatory versus optional.
